headline: symindex (ast-grep path + symbol index) answers in ~90 ms instead of codemap 15-25 s, with Recall@8 >= codemap+rules on ess-be (0.583 vs 0.537 hard units, 0.377 vs 0.296 held-out) and within 0.05 on Laya after a hidden-dir fix; the frozen gate still fails because plain rg beats every engine on the easy held-out units (0.518). Next: agent A/B on hard ess-be tasks with symindex behind a flag.

deviations: Offline comparison only (no agent run); arms are engine/order variants, not plain Claude vs tool.
Frozen run lost on Laya because ast-grep skipped dot-directories (.claude/); fixed in 5218b0f (--no-ignore hidden, versioned cache key) and re-run as a labelled second run (compare-fix.json).
Held-out units not hardness-filtered (design decision); rg beats all engines there.
Default-order rule picks codemap order from the pooled set, driven by Laya; on ess-be held-out rules order is better (0.377 vs 0.216).
